metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2023 · Arnold
metas.description: Follows the life of Arnold Schwarzenegger, from his days of lifting weights to his successes in Hollywood, his time serving as governor of California, and both the joys and volatility of his family life.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · This Is Going to Hurt
metas.description: Set on Labour Ward with all its hilarity and heart-lifting highs but also its gut-wrenching lows, the show delivers a brutally honest depiction of life as a junior doctor on the wards, and the toll the job can take back home.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2024 · Senna
metas.description: The life story of Brazil's most beloved Formula 1 hero, who died in a tragic racing accident at the 1994 San Marino Gran Prix.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2025 · Death by Lightning
metas.description: Dramatizes the stranger-than-fiction true story of 20th U.S. President James Garfield, and admirer Charles Guiteau, who assassinated him.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2022 · Five Days at Memorial
metas.description: Doctors and nurses at the intensive care unit of a New Orleans hospital struggle with treating patients during Hurricane Katrina when the facility is without power for 5 days.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2024 · Mr Bates vs. The Post Office
metas.description: One of the greatest miscarriages of justice in British legal history where hundreds of innocent sub-postmasters and postmistresses were wrongly accused of theft, fraud and false accounting due to a defective IT system.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2023 · A Small Light
metas.description: Follows the remarkable story of Miep Gies, a Dutch woman who risked her life to shelter Anne Frank's family from the Nazis for more than two years during World War II.

metas.name: ★ 7.8 · 2020 · Mrs. America
metas.description: Conservative activist Phyllis Schlafly leads an unexpected fight against the Equal Rights Amendment movement during the 1970s.

metas.name: ★ 8.3 · 2022 · Julia
metas.description: Inspired by Julia Child's extraordinary life and her show The French Chef, which essentially invented food television.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2021 · The Billion Dollar Code
metas.description: In 1990s Berlin, an artist and a hacker invented a new way to see the world. Years later, they reunite to sue Google for patent infringement on it.

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2023 · The Law According to Lidia Poët
metas.description: In late 19th-century Turin, Lidia Poët, fights against everything and everyone to get what is rightfully hers: to be enrolled in the official register of lawyers. Nothing could stop her dream of becoming the first female lawyer in...

metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Aka Charlie Sheen
metas.description: After 7 years sober, Charlie Sheen candidly discusses his rise to fame and public downfall, joined by family and friends who share untold stories of his journey through stardom, struggles, and redemption.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2024 · Mr. McMahon
metas.description: WWE experienced record-breaking highs and crushing lows under Vince McMahon's leadership and the mogul's controversial reign.

metas.name: ★ 7.7 · 2023 · The Long Shadow
metas.description: Dramatizing one of the most infamously notorious serial killer cases, the hunt for the Yorkshire Ripper, between 1975 and 1981. The search involved over a thousand officers and changed the way the British police worked forever.

metas.name: ★ 7.9 · 2023 · Scam 2003 - The Telgi Story
metas.description: Born in Khanapur in Karnataka, Telgi became the mastermind behind one of the most ingenious schemes in Indian history that spread across multiple states and shook the entire country.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2020 · For Life
metas.description: A prisoner becomes a lawyer and fights to overturn his life sentence for a crime he didn't commit.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2022 · Pistol
metas.description: Based on the memoir of Steve Jones, the legendary Sex Pistols guitarist who helped usher in a punk revolution in Britain.

metas.name: ★ 8.8 · 2024 · Ataturk 1881-1919
metas.description: The early life story of Veteran Mustafa Kemal Atatürk, the founding father of the Republic of Turkey and its first President, supreme commander of Turkish War of Independence, and revolutionary statesman.
